Unauthorized Access to Game Analytics Data via API Gateway [Spoofing, Elevation of Privilege, CWE-306] on API Gateway, Cognito User Pool, Kinesis Data Stream: Attackers might attempt to forge Cognito tokens, exploit token validation bugs, or use stolen credentials to gain unauthorized access to the API endpoints. An attacker obtains valid credentials through phishing or token theft, then uses these to submit falsified game analytics data that could skew business metrics or game balance decisions

Data Exposure in S3 Buckets [Information Disclosure, Tampering, CWE-200] on Raw Data S3 Bucket, Processed Data S3 Bucket, Kinesis Firehose: Misconfigured bucket policies, overly permissive IAM roles, or accidentally disabled block public access settings could expose sensitive game analytics data. An attacker discovers a misconfigured S3 bucket policy that allows listing of objects, downloads sensitive game analytics data, and uses it for competitive analysis or to expose player behavior patterns

Kinesis Stream Data Interception [Information Disclosure, Tampering, Repudiation, CWE-319] on Kinesis Data Streams, Kinesis Data Firehose, Kinesis Data Analytics: Insufficient encryption of data in transit or overly permissive IAM policies could allow unauthorized access to real-time game analytics data streams. An attacker with access to the AWS network infrastructure could potentially intercept or modify game analytics data as it flows between services.

EMR Cluster Security Compromise [Elevation of Privilege, Tampering, CWE-732] on EMR Cluster, EMR Service Role, EMR Instance Profile: Attackers could exploit vulnerabilities in EMR applications, misconfigured security groups, or weak SSH access controls to gain unauthorized access to the cluster. An attacker gains access to the EMR cluster through a misconfigured security group, then uses this access to manipulate data processing jobs or access sensitive data.

DynamoDB Game State Manipulation [Tampering, Information Disclosure, Elevation of Privilege, CWE-284] on DynamoDB Table, Processing Lambda, Game State Data: Attackers could exploit overly permissive IAM policies or vulnerabilities in the processing Lambda to manipulate game state data in DynamoDB. An attacker compromises the processing Lambda function and uses its permissions to modify game state data, potentially affecting game balance or player progress.

Analytics Data Privacy Breach [Information Disclosure, Repudiation, CWE-359] on Athena, QuickSight, Processed Data Bucket: Insufficient data anonymization or access controls in analytics systems could expose sensitive player behavior patterns and personal information. An analyst with QuickSight access exports detailed player behavior data containing personally identifiable information, leading to privacy violations.
